# PV-MEPCG / PulseVision -- project structure

Generated by `python scripts/48_project_docs.py` -- do not edit by hand.

Every configuration key and its default is in [CONFIGURATION.md](CONFIGURATION.md).
The scope boundary, install steps and run instructions are in [README.md](README.md).

## The shape of the thing

```
dataset/  read-only input  ->  src/data_loader
                           ->  src/preprocessing       -> cache/signals
                           ->  src/feature_extraction  -> cache/features
                           ->  src/feature_selection
                           ->  src/models, src/ensemble, src/optimization
                           ->  src/evaluation          -> outputs/
                           ->  src/reporting           -> outputs/ tables, figures, packs
                           ->  scripts/17_export_frontend_data.py
                                                       -> frontend/lib/generated/
                           ->  frontend (static export) + src/api (live inference)
```

Nothing downstream reaches back. `src/reporting` reads `outputs/`, never the
dataset; the frontend reads `frontend/lib/generated/`, never `outputs/`; and the
browser reads neither.

## The codegen boundary

**The client never computes, and never declares, a metric.** This is the rule
that matters more than any other in this repository. It is enforced by checks
that run inside `npm run build` -- the build fails if any of them fails --
rather than trusted:

| What | Where | Enforced by |
|---|---|---|
| Numbers are formatted in Python, at build time | `scripts/17_export_frontend_data.py` | prebuild: runs last before `next build`, so the site cannot be built against stale data |
| Pages import from generated/ and nothing else | `frontend/lib/generated/` | scripts/16_check_no_hardcoded_metrics.py (prebuild) |
| No metric literal is typed into a page | `frontend/app/, frontend/components/` | scripts/16_check_no_hardcoded_metrics.py (prebuild) |
| No payload leaks into every route | `frontend/out/` | scripts/20_check_bundle_budget.py (postbuild) |
| Every value on screen re-formats from its source file | `frontend/out/` | scripts/45_audit_displayed_values.py (postbuild) |
| No screenshot of an unaudited page | `outputs/15_dashboard_screenshots/` | scripts/45_audit_displayed_values.py --gate |
| The only runtime call is live inference | `frontend/lib/api.ts` | `POST /predict` in `src/api/main.py`; nothing else crosses the wire |

The rule exists because a parallel implementation of this same brief displayed a
95.82% PhysioNet result its pipeline never produced, and a CirCor validation it
never ran.

## Entry points

Every script is runnable as `python scripts/<name>.py`; all of them are also
stages of `scripts/00_run_everything.py`, which is what reproduces the project.

| Script | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`00_run_everything.py`](scripts/00_run_everything.py) | Reproduce the whole project with one command (T122.1, T122.2). |
| [`01_run_dataset_audit.py`](scripts/01_run_dataset_audit.py) | Run the whole Part II dataset audit from one command (T22.3). |
| [`02_extract_features.py`](scripts/02_extract_features.py) | Extract the 138 features for one or more datasets (Phase 39). |
| [`03_feature_reports.py`](scripts/03_feature_reports.py) | Build FE-03 and every feature report and figure over it (Phases 40-42). |
| [`04_model_smoke.py`](scripts/04_model_smoke.py) | Baseline model smoke runs and the SVM cost benchmark (Phases 46-47). |
| [`05_render_diagrams.py`](scripts/05_render_diagrams.py) | Regenerate every PV-MEPCG diagram from version-controlled source (T97.6). |
| [`05_run_search.py`](scripts/05_run_search.py) | Hyperparameter search runs: SO-01 randomized and SO-02 Bayesian (Phases 54-56). |
| [`06_run_feature_selection.py`](scripts/06_run_feature_selection.py) | SO-04 feature selection: filter, embedded, RFECV, the k sweep and FE-12 (Phase 57). |
| [`07_run_population_search.py`](scripts/07_run_population_search.py) | SO-03a genetic algorithm and SO-03b particle swarm over the feature mask (Phases 58-59). |
| [`08_run_weight_optimization.py`](scripts/08_run_weight_optimization.py) | SO-05: ensemble weight optimization on out-of-fold probabilities (Phase 60). |
| [`09_run_multi_objective.py`](scripts/09_run_multi_objective.py) | SO-06: the performance-versus-complexity Pareto front (Phase 61). |
| [`10_search_reports.py`](scripts/10_search_reports.py) | Part VI reporting: T07 and the figures G20, G21, G22 (Phase 62). |
| [`11_run_experiment.py`](scripts/11_run_experiment.py) | Run one declared experiment end to end (T63.5). |
| [`12_run_all_experiments.py`](scripts/12_run_all_experiments.py) | Chain every mandatory experiment in dependency order (T63.6). |
| [`13_finalize_binary_model.py`](scripts/13_finalize_binary_model.py) | T09, the selection rule, and the persisted binary model (T65.4 - T65.6). |
| [`14_binary_tables.py`](scripts/14_binary_tables.py) | Emit T08 and T10 from a completed binary run (T64.6). |

## Output map

| Directory | Holds |
|---|---|
| `outputs/00_evidence_index/` | evidence index (CSV + XLSX), run manifest, QA and reproducibility reports |
| `outputs/01_dataset_audit/` | DA-01..DA-09: integrity scan, label maps, class counts, split maps |
| `outputs/02_preprocessing/` | PP-01..PP-09: filter responses, segmentation, SQI calibration, the ablation |
| `outputs/03_features/` | FE-01..FE-12: the feature matrix, distributions, correlations, the selected subset |
| `outputs/04_models/` | baseline smoke metrics, model complexity, search spaces, deployed task models |
| `outputs/05_search_optimization/` | SO-01..SO-06: random, Bayesian, GA/PSO, weight and multi-objective searches |
| `outputs/06_binary_results/` | EXP-A1/EXP-A2 and the binary result tables (T08-T10) |
| `outputs/07_multiclass_results/` | EXP-B1/EXP-B2 and the PASCAL tables (T11, T12) |
| `outputs/08_circor_external_validation/` | EXP-C1/EXP-C2/EXP-D1 and the CirCor tables (T13-T15) |
| `outputs/09_ablation/` | preprocessing, feature and optimization ablations |
| `outputs/09_robustness_analysis/` | EXP-E1 noise sweep and EXP-E2 duration truncation |
| `outputs/10_robustness/` | robustness tables and the cross-dataset transfer report |
| `outputs/11_complexity/` | T24-T26: timing, memory and inference-cost analysis |
| `outputs/12_statistics/` | T29-T33: Wilcoxon, Friedman, effect sizes, the significance matrix |
| `outputs/13_figures_diagrams/` | all 35 G-figures and 20 F-diagrams under one figure registry |
| `outputs/14_algorithms/` | ALG-01..ALG-20, exported from the code |
| `outputs/15_dashboard_screenshots/` | SS-01..SS-13, captured from the built dashboard behind the audit gate |
| `outputs/16_literature_review/` | LIT-01 review and LIT-02 indicative comparison (objective 2) |
| `outputs/Q1_PAPER_ASSETS/` | the Q1 paper pack, rebuilt from the sources it quotes |
| `outputs/THESIS_ASSETS/` | the thesis pack, copies checked by newline-normalized digest |
| `outputs/configs/` | the frozen environment: pip freeze, resolved configs, package versions |
| `outputs/logs/` | rotating run logs (gitignored; the manifest is not) |

Other top-level directories:

| Directory | Holds |
|---|---|
| `configs/` | the five YAML files -- see [CONFIGURATION.md](CONFIGURATION.md) |
| `models_saved/` | one deployed model per task plus its manifest (binaries gitignored, manifests committed) |
| `cache/` | preprocessed signals and feature shards keyed by config digest -- regenerable, gitignored |
| `frontend/` | the Next.js dashboard; `frontend/out/` is the committed static export |
| `tests/` | the pytest suite, including the five MEGA TEST modules |
| `dataset/` | read-only input, 1.3 GB, gitignored -- never written to |
